svg.aria-label: Re-simulation throughput against worker count: 162 ticks per second at 1 worker, 612 at 4, 746 at 6, 900 at 8, 954 at 12, 1150 at 16, 1160 at 20. The milestone had assumed saturation at 6 workers; the real plateau is between 16 and 20.
